info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Asset Securitization Information API
info.description: The Asset Securitization Information API provides access to detailed data regarding asset securitization processes within the banking treasury framework. Users can retrieve specific asset securitization records by providing the relevant parameters. This API is beneficial for financial analysts, compliance officers, and banking professionals interested in understanding and managing asset-backed securities. It supports use cases such as portfolio analysis, regulatory reporting, and financial decision-making.

get.description: Fetches the detailed information of a specific asset securitization identified by its unique ID. This endpoint provides all relevant data associated with asset securitization for better decision-making and analysis.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve asset securitization details specific to the RES-100045 identifier. It takes in a JSON object formatted according to the specified schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the asset securitization resource.

GetAssetSecuritizationByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the body of the request for the GET operation related to asset securitization in the treasury system.
